objective: Execute an explicitly chosen change in asset-unit holdings; never select the user's target or forecast alpha.
quantity_model: long-only asset units; integer quantity-step lots; quote-currency fees; no borrowing or shorting

volatility.estimator: RMS of last 20 log returns between 21 completed session references
volatility.floor: one price tick divided by current reference
volatility.availability: reference time and available-at must both be no later than decision time

ladder.allocation: equal integer lots with remainder assigned to nearer rungs
ladder.deadline_distance_factor: max(0.25, 1 - elapsed eligible trading time fraction)

deadline_schedule: Fixed initial task lots times elapsed eligible trading time through next review, minus actual filled lots and all still-reserved task lots; no reset from remaining lots. Integer floor until final checkpoint.
no_deadline_schedule: Explicit weekly quantity allowance minus actual weekly fills and all still-open task lots. Weekly allowance is a cap, not an implied completion horizon. Null deadline never triggers tightening or closeout.
closeout: Separate scenario only: at explicit predeadline cutoff request cancellations, wait for acknowledgments, then use a fresh executable-price assumption for remaining feasible units. An unacknowledged cancel retains reservations. Market completion is never guaranteed.
metrics: all-target implementation shortfall including residual marked at common terminal mid
inference: Synthetic engineering stress tests only. Scenario frequencies are not calibrated market probabilities; no historical or prospective performance claim. Pareto comparisons within each side/path/mode/scenario only. No pooled best-policy claim.
future_evaluation: Frozen prospective timestamped policy receipts and untouched chronological data after readiness approval; historical inputs already inspected are development data only; meaningful independent episodes and prespecified uncertainty methodology must be justified before inferential claims.
